description: Click an element by its visible text — no CSS selector needed. Uses fuzzy matching across text content, aria-label, title, placeholder, and value. Returns match score and alternatives. Like Stagehand act('Click login') but without LLM cost. Use when you know WHAT to click but not the exact selector.

text.description: Visible text of the element to click (e.g. 'Login', 'Submit Order', 'Learn more')

name: browser_smart_click
